_nota: Inglés de testbeds.json (2026-11-15): castellano exacto → inglés, que `i18n.localized` aplica al servir (evidence/testbeds.py); el original no se toca. Se traduce lo que redacta EMMA: dónde está cada frase en su página (`where`), lo que cada banco deja fuera y por qué, las deducciones de la matriz RIDGE, `context_basis`, `emma_use`, lo buscado y no encontrado (`not_found`, de columna y general), las dos validaciones y los nombres de banco que son una descripción en castellano. La escalera y `variables_kb` son celdas de tablas de la base de conocimiento del equipo: aquí va su traducción, y el literal castellano sigue en el documento que nombra `where`. NO se traducen, por ser citas literales: `quote` (frase de la página, en su idioma), `rule.text` y `principle.text` (documentos del equipo), ni lo que va entre «» dentro de un texto. Tampoco identificadores, fechas ni `figures_in` (una ruta con los títulos de un documento en castellano). Una entrada con el mismo texto a los dos lados es un nombre propio o un rótulo de la fuente que ya está en inglés. Traducción automática, sin revisar por una persona; lo vigila tests/test_inventories_en.py.

strings.La página del NBL ofrece «Extensive vide: The NBL page offers «Extensive video, audio and instrumentation capabilities», without saying what data remain or where (reread on 2026-10-31).

strings.La flotabilidad simula gravedad total o: Buoyancy simulates full or partial gravity for moving and handling masses («to simulate full or partial gravity»), not on the body; «Step 2» says of these pools that they do not give the long-term effect of microgravity.
strings.La página no trata el agua ni el traje c: The page does not treat the water or the suit as the closed environment of a spacecraft.

strings.Lo que estudian sobre todo es la presión: What they study above all is the pressure before and during a spacewalk (hypobaric chambers): neither bed rest nor an isolation study, even though the volunteers live confined for about two weeks. No value of the enumeration covers it and the enumeration is not extended.
strings.Son cámaras en Tierra con la presión por: They are chambers on Earth with the pressure below atmospheric; the pages do not list it.
strings.«Specifications»: la capacidad de la cám: «Specifications»: the capacity of the 20-foot chamber, not the number of a study
strings.Ni la ficha de las cámaras (releída el 2: Neither the chambers page (reread on 2026-10-31) nor the 2015 page says what data remain or where.
strings.La ficha de las cámaras dice qué protoco: The chambers page says which protocols are tested (nitrogen replacement, air compositions), not which parameters are measured in the volunteers.
strings.Ni la ficha ni la página de 2015 nombran: Neither the chambers page nor the 2015 page names investigators.

strings.Los voluntarios viven y trabajan dentro: The volunteers live and work inside the chamber for about two weeks («volunteers live and work inside a three-story, 20-foot diameter chamber»), and the 2015 page says that the chambers also simulate confinement.
strings.La página de 2015 dice que en las simula: The 2015 page says that in the earlier long simulations (56 and 91 days) resupply and face-to-face contact were limited («limit supply replenishment and face-to-face contact with the crew»); the current chambers page says nothing of the kind about the two-week missions.
strings.Gravedad de la Tierra: la planta baja si: Earth gravity: the ground floor simulates the movements and workload of a spacewalk, not gravity.
strings.Presión por debajo de la atmosférica y o: Pressure below atmospheric and other air compositions («different atmospheric compositions»), the environment before and during a spacewalk; not the rest of the closed environment of a spacecraft.
strings.Enfermedad descompresiva y protocolos de: Decompression sickness and spacewalk protocols: EMMA does not watch them and uses no altitude chamber data.
Real microgravity and a real crew.

strings.Ni «Step 2», ni las cifras de la estació: Neither «Step 2», nor the station facts and figures, nor the health FAQ says where the data end up. EMMA has no vital signs from the ISS: they are protected medical data and there is no public API.

strings.Radiación espacial real, pero en órbita: Real space radiation, but in low Earth orbit («about 250 miles above Earth»): the knowledge base (§3) gives «LEO» as a limitation, not deep space.
strings.Una tripulación confinada en la estación: A crew confined on the station for long stays («extended stays in space», «Step 2»).
strings.La base de conocimiento (§3) da como lim: The knowledge base (§3) gives as a limitation «LEO, soporte Tierra, resupply/evacuación relativa» (LEO, Earth support, relative resupply/evacuation); the «Step 2» page does not list it, and the Johnson health FAQ (2024) says that in an emergency the crew returns to Earth («If a medical emergency requires a return to Earth, the crew will return in the spacecraft they launched aboard to receive urgent medical care on the ground.»).
strings.Microgravedad real («The microgravity en: Real microgravity («The microgravity environment on the space station affects the human body in a variety of ways», «Step 2»).
strings.Una nave cerrada; «Step 2» estudia, entr: A closed spacecraft; «Step 2» studies, among other things, the CO2 of the station («carbon dioxide levels on the space station»).
strings.Respuesta real en microgravedad. La base: Real response in microgravity. The knowledge base also gives it an operational use («comportamiento operacional real», real operational behaviour), but with Earth in real time: the operational validation that the ideation conversation asks for, a crew alone with the system, is that of HERA, CHAPEA or MMEA. EMMA has no vital signs from the ISS: they are protected medical data and there is no public API; from the ISS it cites OSD-288, which are mice (immunological support, not telemetry).
strings.La relación fisiológica: en análogos con: The physiological relationship: in controlled analogs, on the ISS and in flight data.
strings.Motor de medida y tasa de falsa alarma s: Measurement engine and false alarm rate on healthy people on Earth (MMASH), with the sensitivity measured on deteriorations injected into that same physiology: the two metrics together.
strings.No valida fisiología espacial ni la deri: It does not validate space physiology or the drift of a mission: they are healthy people on Earth for one day.
strings.Hemograma real de los cuatro tripulantes: Real blood count of the four civilian crew members of Inspiration4 (OSDR), replayed to see the postflight trajectory against each one's preflight range.
strings.Sin muestras en vuelo y con un vuelo de: No in-flight samples and a three-day flight: it does not validate a long mission, and EMMA does not alert on the drop in lymphocytes on return because there is no personal baseline.
strings.Ni reposo en cama, ni ISS, ni una misión: Neither bed rest, nor the ISS, nor a long mission: there is no public API of astronaut vital signs.
strings.Que una tripulación use el sistema sola,: That a crew uses the system alone, without Earth in real time.
strings.EMMA no ha pasado por HERA, CHAPEA, MMEA: EMMA has not been through HERA, CHAPEA, MMEA or NEEMO.
strings.La página «Step 1, Earth» no dice que ni: The «Step 1, Earth» page does not say that no site reproduces Mars in full, as the ideation conversation attributed to it; the knowledge base says it (§3: «no existe banco de prueba completo», no complete testbed exists).
strings.La página «Step 1, Earth» llama al labor: The «Step 1, Earth» page calls the Brookhaven laboratory «National Space Radiation Laboratory»; Brookhaven calls it «NASA Space Radiation Laboratory».
strings.Ni la página del programa MMEA ni su anu: Neither the MMEA programme page nor its announcement mentions the communication delay; the programme page gives no publication date (reread on 2026-10-31).
strings.Tras la relectura del 2026-10-31 siguen: After the rereading of 2026-10-31, ARGOS, the parabolic flights, the NBL and Loma Linda are still without a number of participants; HERA, MMEA and Loma Linda, without a manufacturer, integrator or operator; and all the testbeds except the NSRL without saying where their data end up (the catalogue of the samples of irradiated animals is in the LSDA, which requires a request); the Loma Linda and MMEA pages say who the results go to, not where they end up. Antarctica gains participants (24 subjects of two 2019 studies), an operator (the NSF and the USAP) and investigators; the ISS, the duration of a stay, the crew, who operates it and three contractors; no page gives where the medical data of the ISS end up.
strings.Ni la página de ARGOS (la de trajes espa: Neither the ARGOS page (Johnson's spacesuit page), nor its patent page, nor the parabolic flights page shows a publication date; neither of the two NEEMO pages mentions data.
strings.La página del hábitat de CHAPEA nombra a: The CHAPEA habitat page names ICON («ICON’s next generation Vulcan construction system», and the image credit) and not BIG: no NASA page that was read attributes the habitat to BIG.
strings.Ninguna página leída dice cuánto dura un: No page that was read says how long a session lasts in ARGOS or in the NBL, or an exposure at the NSRL or at Loma Linda; that of a stay on the ISS is given by the Johnson health FAQ («about six months»).
strings.Solo las fichas de misión de HERA, de la: Only the mission pages of HERA, of the Antarctic stations and of the NSRL name the hazard they study («Hazards»), and the «Antarctic Stations» page of the «NSF» link adds «Hazards Tested: Hostile environment, isolation»; that of the altitude chambers and that of the Space Radiation Element do not have that field. Outside those pages, only the NEEMO studies page says which hazard it studies («focus on isolation, confinement»); the rest of the RIDGE matrix is EMMA's deduction.
strings.El catálogo de análogos de NASA remite e: NASA's analog catalogue refers the Kraken to a video, not to a nasa.gov page (what was read is a NASA release of 2023), and puts HERA among the «Past Analogs»; its mission page says «Occurred 2 years ago».
strings.De las columnas que pedía la conversació: Of the columns that the ideation conversation asked for, «Measured parameters», «Equipment», «Investigators» and «Experiments» come in on 2026-10-31 with a sentence where the page gives one; «Limitations» is «What it leaves out»; «ISS / Moon / Mars application» and «Opportunity» are given by no page and are EMMA's judgement (`emma_use` and the ladder).
strings.Investigadores por su nombre solo los da: Investigators by name are given only by the «Antarctic Stations» page of the «NSF» link (Brian Crucian and Satish Mehta, without a position), the CHAPEA programme page (Grace Douglas, «principal investigator») and the 2021 article on investigation 7562 of the ISS (Grace Douglas, with her 2021 position); the other testbed pages name none.
strings.La investigación 7562 del ISS Research E: Investigation 7562 of the ISS Research Explorer could not be reread on 2026-10-31: the page serves the template without the investigation and the API that fills it (api-g.iss.nasa.gov) answers 404 on the routes tried; the page #id=975 that the ideation conversation gave is still unresolved for the same reason. What EMMA cites of the study comes from the NASA article of 2021 and the 2020 poster (NTRS).
strings.De los proveedores de la ISS que nombrab: Of the ISS providers that the ideation conversation named, Boeing (2010), Teledyne Brown (2022) and CASIS (2022) have a NASA document that was read; of COLSA, no live nasa.gov page was found on 2026-10-31 (the 2012 release on the HOSC contract returns 404; the fact sheets of the POIC and of Marshall and the Marshall Star of August 2012 do not name it).
strings.El centro de protones de Loma Linda entr: The Loma Linda proton centre comes in only through the Space Radiation Element page, which names it and links protons.com: that page is a hospital's, not NASA's, and is not cited; what NASA irradiates there, how long it lasts and who operates it remain without a source that was read.
